title: Macron warns student anger is being exploited as France braces for more protests
content: With high schools still blocked in several French cities, student unions are urging protests to merge in a fresh nationwide day of action on Saturday 17 October.
snippet: With high schools still blocked in several French cities, student unions are urging protests to merge in a fresh nationwide day of action on Saturday 17 October.

title: Le Pen lands in Brussels lashing out at the European Commission
content: The French far-right leader wants to strip powers from the EU and cap France’s net contribution to the bloc’s budget at €5 billion a year. “Being pro-France does not mean being anti-Europe,” she says.

title: Meloni warns Trump's Russian diesel deal is 'very risky' and legitimises Moscow
content: Italy's prime minister has attacked the US-Russia diesel deal, warning it weakens sanctions on Moscow. Zelensky thanked her, while the Kremlin hit back.

title: Florence’s 'Maricarmen': 94-year-old faces losing her home of 60 years as rent nearly triples
content: The elderly widow, almost blind and using a walking frame still does not know about the eviction; her daughter says her story echoes Maricarmen, a symbol of Spain's fight for housing.
snippet: The elderly widow, almost blind and using a walking frame still does not know about the eviction; her daughter says her story echoes Maricarmen, a symbol of Spain's fight for housing.

title: Are Hungary and the EU friends again? The Ring in Budapest
content: The Ring visits Budapest to ask whether Prime Minister Péter Magyar has reset Hungary’s ties with the EU. After April’s landslide, Brussels agreed to release €16.4bn in blocked funds, but several issues remain unresolved.

title: Violence in Paris as tens of thousands turn out for student protests across France
content: French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said 11 police officers had been hospitalised following clashes with protesters in Paris on Tuesday.

title: EU advances Ukraine accession as Hungary lifts veto, paving way for Zelenskyy-Magyar meeting
content: EU governments agreed to open two additional accession clusters with Ukraine after Hungary dropped its veto following an agreement on the rights of the ethnic Hungarian minority. Zelenskyy and Magyar may meet in Brussels later this week.

title: Russian strike injures dozens at Rivne University as ballistic missiles hit Kyiv
content: Russian strikes caused injuries and deaths across Ukraine on Tuesday, including at a university in Rivne and civilian infrastructure in Kyiv.

title: ‘Act five’: National Assembly opens budget debate amid ongoing student protests in France
content: The French government's budget proposal includes a €1.2 billion increase in funding for the National Education Ministry, as France grapples with one of the highest public deficits in the eurozone.

title: US ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns
content: US President Donald Trump said on Monday that his administration was "looking at" firing Guilfoyle and that they were "not happy" with the situation.
